scope: Ordinary bounded development review and authorized Docker entrypoint repair. No formal red team, model/API/network calls, Docker builds, package installation, or remote actions.

finding.description: The declared task-engine image entrypoint bypassed run_eval.sh, silently ignoring compose trial/seed/log defaults and optional output path. The shell wrapper was not copied into the image.
finding.reproduction: Execute declared ENTRYPOINT with stub python, then parse recorded arguments through real eval_runner parser; env trials=7/seed=19/output path were not preserved and positional task was invalid.
finding.fix: Copy and execute run_eval.sh; consume environment defaults; accept positional task or direct simulation flags; preserve child status/streams; remove unused task-engine MCP_URL/SEED_CONFIG and misleading HTTP dependency comment.

review_checks: Installed entrypoint and module both resolve healthcraft.cli.main; actual evaluate forwards arguments to orchestrator; simulate remains explicit.
Argparse rejects nonpositive trials/max_tasks before model preflight.
stdio/HTTP distinction and HTTP loopback binding/child exit propagation match documentation.
Optional mcp floor is >=1.29.0; installed 1.29.0 metadata declares Python>=3.10. Existing runtime Python3.13.14 uses uvicorn0.37.0.
CI matrix requests core/dev on Python3.10 and dev,mcp on Python3.12 with shared constraints; no fresh resolution/install claimed.
README states source-checkout configuration requirement and ungraded/independent task-engine simulation scope.
limits: Shell entrypoint tested on host using the literal Dockerfile ENTRYPOINT plus copied wrapper; container image was not built or launched.
Existing optional SDK was tested earlier in a separate bounded peer review; new CI installation/resolution was inspected, not executed.
Broad unchanged orchestrator task-selection and grading semantics are outside this patch review; this receipt is not benchmark or clinical validation.
